title: Noël Burtt Featured Speaker at the GlySpace Alliance Webinar Series June 3, 2025
bodyHtml:
Our very own Noël Burtt will be speaking at the GlySpace Alliance Webinar Series tomorrow, June 3 at 10 AM ET! We invite you to join us for a presentation on "The Common Fund Data Ecosystem: a unique model for a resource of resources for the biomedical community."
 
Further details are available in the attached flyer, please circulate it to interested colleagues!
 
Join the webinar: https://gwu-edu.zoom.us/j/91498498310
summary: Our very own Noël Burtt will be speaking at the GlySpace Alliance Webinar Series tomorrow, June 3 at 10 AM ET!
